definitions.d: SAM 3 tracker seeded with b's seed (the bound GT instance on its largest anchor) on that anchor's position in the dense sequence (dense.py), carried forward and backward over every dense frame, read out at the 32 served anchors under K1's carry rule; same lift and fit as a, e, t, s, b.
definitions.d_reading: registered bars on d-a over the d population: >= 8 with lower bound > 0 -> source_when_dense (checked first); else <= 4 with upper bound < 8, or d no better than b (mean d-b <= 0) -> not_the_source; otherwise undecided. d-t, e-a, b-a are descriptive.
definitions.d_population: per unit, the items whose capture has status OK in its manifest (DENSE_D.json, DENSE_D_ARK.json); pooled joins both and exists only when both units are complete; see d.<population>.population.label.
definitions.share: (k-a)/(e-a): ratio of item means; interval from the ratio of the same bootstrap draws.
definitions.precision_recall: per (item, operand, anchor) with GT or prediction nonempty; precision mean over frames with prediction nonempty, recall mean over frames with GT nonempty.
definitions.other_cells: a, e, t, s, b and their sections are defined as in RELIFT_GTCB.json and equal it.
